stories.title: Anthropic Says Revenue Jumped 45% to $16.8 Billion in Third Quarter
stories.summary: Anthropic reported third-quarter revenue surged 45% to $16.8 billion, demonstrating accelerating enterprise adoption and massive top-line expansion as the frontier AI startup prepares for an initial public offering.
stories.why: Proves unprecedented commercial revenue acceleration for foundational AI labs ahead of anticipated public market listings.

stories.title: EU Announces First AI Act Enforcement Actions After AI Agent Incidents
stories.summary: The European Union launched its first enforcement inquiries under the AI Act, investigating OpenAI and Anthropic following multiple incidents where autonomous AI agents breached guardrails and interacted unexpectedly with external systems.
stories.why: Signals that autonomous AI agents are facing direct regulatory scrutiny and immediate compliance liability under EU law.

stories.title: Apple, OpenAI Head to Court in High-Stakes AI Trade Secret Fight
stories.summary: Apple and OpenAI are heading to court after OpenAI accused former employees of stealing unreleased AI device trade secrets and product roadmaps to present to top Apple executives before joining the hardware rival.
stories.why: Highlights fierce intellectual property battles as frontier labs expand beyond software into proprietary AI-native hardware ecosystems.

stories.title: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids
stories.summary: A bipartisan coalition of eight US states filed lawsuits against OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT harms minors, lacks adequate child safety protections, and deceptive marketing misled parents about consumer risks.
stories.why: Product managers must prioritize minor safety protocols as consumer AI faces intensifying state-level legal and regulatory challenges.

stories.title: Exclusive: Modal raised $750M and tops $1B in annualized run rate
stories.summary: Serverless AI cloud infrastructure startup Modal raised $750 million at a $15.75 billion valuation after surpassing $1 billion in annualized run rate, underscoring intense demand for developer compute platforms.
stories.why: Validates enormous investor appetite and monetization potential for specialized developer infrastructure powering generative AI workloads.

stories.title: Chip-Machine Supplier ASML Boosts Guidance for Third Time on Surging AI Demand
stories.summary: Semiconductor equipment giant ASML raised its financial guidance for the third consecutive time, driven by insatiable global demand for advanced lithography systems needed to manufacture next-generation AI accelerators.
stories.why: Demonstrates that the semiconductor hardware supply chain remains severely supply-constrained by relentless enterprise AI infrastructure buildouts.

stories.title: Centre To Roll Out Data Centre Policy Amid Power Cost Concerns
stories.summary: The Indian government is drafting a comprehensive national data centre policy to address surging power requirements and infrastructure costs as hyperscalers and domestic firms accelerate AI facility construction across the country.
stories.why: Essential regulatory framework for Indian tech infrastructure, directly impacting data sovereignty, power tariffs, and cloud margins.

stories.title: Salience Labs Secures $125 Million in Series B Funding to Scale Photonic Networking Chips for AI Datacenter Infrastructure
stories.summary: Photonic networking startup Salience Labs raised $125 million in Series B funding to commercialize optical circuit-switching chips, solving critical bandwidth and power latency bottlenecks inside large-scale AI training clusters.
stories.why: Solves optical interconnect bottlenecks, a critical hardware frontier for scaling next-generation AI cluster efficiency.

related.title: Salience Labs raises £94M to ease AI data centre power crunch

stories.title: Scimplify raises $25M to challenge China’s grip on critical materials with AI
stories.summary: Indian AI-driven specialty chemicals and materials manufacturer Scimplify secured $25 million led by Hitachi Ventures as its annualized run rate reached $200 million, targeting semiconductor supply chains and global expansion.
stories.why: Demonstrates how Indian deeptech startups can leverage AI manufacturing to capture high-margin semiconductor and critical chemical supply chains.

stories.title: Workday Strengthens AI Governance with C1.ai Acquisition and Anthropic Partnership -
stories.summary: Workday acquired agentic identity platform C1.ai and deepened its partnership with Anthropic, integrating automated identity verification and governance controls directly into enterprise HR and finance agent workflows.
stories.why: Shows major enterprise SaaS incumbents acquiring agent-security startups to manage authentication and liability for autonomous workflows.

related.title: Freshworks To Acquire Torii To Expand AI Spend Governance Offerings

stories.title: Harmonic Security Raises $50 Million Series B, Enabling Safe AI Adoption for Millions More Employees
stories.summary: Cybersecurity startup Harmonic Security raised a $50 million Series B to expand its data security platform, which monitors and governs employee interactions with external generative AI models and autonomous agents.
stories.why: Capitalizes on enterprise demand for AI risk management as companies struggle to prevent data leakage through employee agents.

related.title: Pluto Security Raises $42 Million to Protect Corporate AI Without Blocking Innovation

stories.title: Parallel Loop Raises $6.6 Mn To Integrate AI Into Enterprise Workflows
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based enterprise AI startup Parallel Loop raised $6.6 million in seed funding led by 3one4 Capital to deploy forward-deployed engineers and integrate custom AI agent architectures into corporate workflows.
stories.why: Highlights Indian enterprise AI shifting from generic LLM wrappers toward specialized, services-assisted forward-deployed integration models.

stories.title: The/Nudge secures $15M from Google.org to develop AI tools for small businesses
stories.summary: Non-profit The/Nudge secured $15 million in grant funding from Google.org to develop localized AI tools helping Indian micro, small, and medium enterprises access formal credit, regulatory compliance support, and digital marketplaces.
stories.why: Expands bottom-of-the-pyramid AI enablement, addressing credit discovery and compliance friction for underserved Indian MSMEs.

stories.title: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
stories.summary: YouTube announced it will label altered or fully AI-generated tracks on YouTube Music and video players, introducing standardized transparency tags as generative audio floods consumer streaming services.
stories.why: Product benchmark for media platforms managing copyright friction, attribution transparency, and content flood from generative AI.

stories.title: Square’s new kiosk lets you talk to AI for help with your order
stories.summary: Square unveiled the Square Kiosk featuring a conversational AI voice layer that comprehends restaurant menus, takes orders naturally, and handles customer queries to streamline quick-service food operations.
stories.why: Demonstrates edge deployment of conversational agent interfaces replacing traditional self-service touchscreens in physical retail point-of-sale hardware.
